fields.summary_ko.0: In Berkshire Hathaway's (BRKA -0.47%, BRKB -0.36%) public equity portfolio, Apple (AAPL -1.90%) represents 25% as largest holding held for 11 years, peaking at 50% weighting after first purchase in Q1 2016.
fields.summary_ko.1: Despite Apple's elevated PER of 36.8x (Q3 basis), Berkshire has not sold a single share through 2026, expressing commitment to its value philosophy of permanent ownership of excellent businesses and management.
